cancer_indication: KRAS G12C-mutated non-small cell lung cancer
moa: Adagrasib is a covalent, mutant-selective inhibitor of KRAS G12C that binds to the inactive GDP-bound state, suppressing downstream RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK and PI3K–AKT–mTOR signaling, leading to reduced proliferation and tumor regression in KRAS G12C-mutant NSCLC.

HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING.description: Involves PI3K activation leading to AKT and mTOR signaling, promoting cell survival and growth.
HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING.interpretation: PI3K–AKT–mTOR signaling contributes to survival and resistance in KRAS-mutant NSCLC.

notes: Limited data on resistance pathways in breast cancer; see citations.
